en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is of the nature to ripen (*vipākadhammadhamma*), a state that is neither of the nature to ripen nor wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; under predominance [condition] there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are three.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is of the nature to ripen, a state that is neither of the nature to ripen nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; under predominance [condition] there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are three.

Conditioned by a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants and is indeterminate, there arises a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants and is not indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
